Claude Code's "Heads up" notice now sits right above the input box, so Collie on the phone can read it and send again.

- The repository chin (repo, branch, diff and chips) and the progress line now go above bands other plugins draw over the input box, instead of under them. Claude Code's "Heads up" notice (`1: Learn more   2: Knew this already   0: Dismiss`) answers to a digit typed in the box, and Collie reads it as a card only when nothing but blank rows stands between its keys and the box. With the chin in between, Collie read the screen as unreadable and held every send from the phone
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.72.2 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
